parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, arrest pattern, police targeting, or documented universal facility/border exclusion; same-sex conduct is lawful. That removes tier-1/2 exposure. Limiting factors are tier-3: documented verbal abuse and discrimination in some public services including health, societal stigma/vulnerability to harassment, family/community violence, no hate-crime or general anti-discrimination protection for gender identity, and 2024 trans-inclusive decrees with no sourced enforcement in a trans case. Official Pride endorsement signals some acceptance, but day-to-day rejection and thin recourse remain. Detention and document-marker practice are undocumented open questions, not established exposures, and absent legal gender recognition is a resident gap not deducted. Overall elevated-to-reduced risk.
